notes.title: 🤖 I Expect You To Die 3 is Now Available. Robot Antics Trailer Reveal, and More
notes.content:
[h2]Official Launch and Robot Antics Trailer Reveal 🤖[/h2]

Agents, by now you know that Dr. Prism is a major force to be reckoned with in [i]I Expect You To Die 3[/i]… but what do you really know about Robutler and the rest of Dr. Prism’s robot cronies?? 🤖

[previewyoutube=0pxQ8R-WYbs;full][/previewyoutube]

Don’t let their seemingly endearing curiosity (and jokes 🤔?) fool you — they are …somewhat-automated and not to be trusted, Agent!

Now available, Agents can enter the third installment of the beloved spy-fi VR franchise filled with complex and dangerous puzzles, exciting espionage, a sprinkle of hilarity thrown in, and a wild ride of robot antics to round out this death-defying (or implying) adventure. 

[b]Additionally, Agents who enlist within the first week will get a 10% off launch discount![/b]

Don't let Robutler make a joke out of you, Agent. Stay sharp. 💥

[h2]Today’s Schell Games 360 Livestream 🕹️[/h2]

[previewyoutube=9Nm3ft7zLjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Still want insider information on the making of [i]I Expect You To Die 3[/i]? Join us today at 12pm PT / 3pm ET! We’ll be talking with [i]IEYTD3[/i] [b]Game Designer Joey Z.[/b], during today’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Nm3ft7zLjI&utm_campaign=ieytd3_youtube_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Schell Games 360 livestream[/url], so bring your questions and your field agency expertise. 

[h2]An Operation: PAX West Debriefing 🗞️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683070/75bc0f18683bc2883f0e35fdd68166d44e2f72e3.png[/img] 

More than 1,000 agents from across the globe completed their field training at our PAX West pop-up HQ in Seattle. Thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth to update their Agency file, complete [i]IEYTD3[/i] training, and pick up the latest and greatest secret agent gear. It was great to talk with our agents from near and far. You all are the best of the best!

[h2]Our First Official Handler Week is Complete ✅[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683070/94e429fd2ae728144d08b753030523e23a58dfff.png[/img]

Thank you so much to our field operatives for taking part in [b]our first-ever Handler Week[/b] last week ✨. Hopefully, Shawn in HR will get off our back now. He's always going on about The Handler and how we don't appreciate his wit and expertise!
 
Here is a quick intel highlight recap of our findings from last week:
[list][*] 📽️A new Schell Games Documentary Short: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3dn5q2kRX6c&utm_campaign=ieytd3_youtube_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Lead Them To Cleverness - An Interview with Jared Mason ([i]I Expect You To Die[/i])[/url]
[*] 🎧 From our friends at [url=https://www.rufftalkvr.com/?utm_campaign=ieytd3_rufftalk_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=rufftalk&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Ruff Talk VR[/url]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fGDejLVdIek&utm_campaign=ieytd3_youtube_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Interview with Jared Mason the Sr. Design Manager at Schell Games and Voice of "The Handler"[/url]
[*] A joyous day in the Schell Games studio with Bear Archer: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a2ZbQAxw73Y&utm_campaign=ieytd3_youtube_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch][i]I Expect You To Die[/i] 🐻 A Day with Bear Archer at Schell Games[/url]
[*] 💥 BONUS: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tT7DOnAcFDM&utm_campaign=ieytd3_youtube_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=youtube&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch][i]I Expect You To Die 3[/i] 🎤 Message from Special Agent Haley Reinhart[/url] with [i]IEYTD3[/i] soundtrack now available on most streaming platforms![/list]And of course, speaking of Bear Archer… 🏹🐻👀

[h2]Mission Update: Bear Archer Plush Makeship Campaign Success! 🎊[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683070/bf8c55efc0c02b6896ff9e1e9a98cbdb7d4e4d36.png[/img]

We did it, Agents! 🎉 [b]The ZC-07 Security Turret, aka “Bear Archer” plush was successfully funded.[/b] We couldn’t have done it without you. No really — in all seriousness. 

Our associates at Makeship have started production, and all secret operatives who ordered their very own cute-but-deadly bear plush can [b]expect shipping to commence on or around Friday, December 15, 2023.[/b] 

For more information about shipment timelines, please refer to this page of the [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/bear-archer-plush?utm_campaign=ieytd3_makeship_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=makeship&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Bear Archer instruction manual.[/url]

[h2]A First-Time Tokyo Game Show Appearance 👀[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683070/d385d83fe471995a8908897003c554234ff1b60f.png[/img]

We also took the show — er — Agency on the road to [url=https://tgsvr.com/?utm_campaign=ieytd3_tgs_steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=tgs&utm_content=&utm_term=ieytdsteamlaunch]Tokyo Game Show VR[/url]! This online experience that runs alongside the in-person event allows agents to create avatars and visit “Game Islands” — a veritable game country floating in a digital sky. 

[b]You can travel to the world of games to check out I Expect You To Die 3 now through Sunday, October 8, 2023. 🗼[/b]

That’s all for now, Agents. It was quite the briefing.

Stay sharp! ☎️

notes.title: 💥 AGENCY INTEL UPDATE: IEYTD3, Schell Games 360, PAX West, and More!
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!

We know you’re eagerly awaiting your return to the field! [b]Your mission clearance for [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] will be granted on September 28, 2023.[/b] But to help the wait not feel too long, we've got some exciting [i]IEYTD3[/i] events and intel to share with you in the meantime! Both now and coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/a93859216db69bed8dd7ac537ed98f1d92ec3bec.png[/img]
Today at 3pm ET/12pm PT, we’ll be hosting our very first [b]Schell Games 360[/b] livestream. Here, you can expect a closer look at the making of [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] as we take you behind-the-scenes with some of the finest agents Schell Games has to offer! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Y8PVwINKVA]Tune in here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/75bc0f18683bc2883f0e35fdd68166d44e2f72e3.png[/img]
Do you want more? Well, look no further!

Schell Games is excited to let our secret operatives know that we’ll be attending [url=https://west.paxsite.com/]PAX West 2023[/url] with a pop-up Agency Training booth experience! Here, fans — eh hem, Agents — will be able to meet our crew 🌟, demo the new game 🎮, update their agent codex with some cutting-edge technology 📸, and potentially walk away with [spoiler]REDACTED DUE TO HYPE LEVELS[/spoiler] at [b]Booth 2039 in the Summit building from September 1 to 4[/b].

Oh wait! — [b]I’m getting a new classified briefing from HQ... [/b]

[b]It seems ZC-07 Security Turret[/b], also known as 🐻🏹 “Bear Archer”, was successfully repurposed for Agency use. The research team is quite excited to provide agents all over the globe with a mini version of ZC-07, though we aren’t quite sure if it works just yet. At least it’s cute. 🥺 Make sure you’re following our regular correspondence channels for the latest operative updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28147648/ac5cc8ed966774da685a4e96ae19daef30253d70.png[/img]
It also seems [b]Agent Cigar Handler[/b] is expanding research around ZC-07 via [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Or6iVXMv9BM&utm_campaign=ieytd3_contentcreator_steamblog&utm_medium=youtube&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch]Operation: Build-A-Bear[/url]. It’s unusual for agents to post their movements on YouTube of all places, but we hope he can complete the mission before his credentials are compromised. (If they aren’t already.)

You still want MORE? Fine, Agents. We can be flexible every once and awhile — but don’t misunderstand. Shawn in HR will hear about this. 

Speaking of classified intel — Agents should also keep their eyes peeled for special discounts on [url=https://iexpectyoutodie.schellgames.com/original?utm_campaign=ieytd3_ieytdwebsite_steamblog&utm_medium=website&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch][i]I Expect You To Die[/i][/url] and [i][url=https://iexpectyoutodie.schellgames.com/sequel?utm_campaign=ieytd3_ieytd2website_steamblog&utm_medium=website&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=metalaunch]I Expect You To Die 2[/url][/i] in celebration of our launch. What can we say, Agents — we couldn’t announce everything in this briefing. (Shawn in HR wouldn’t let us.)

Stay sharp!

notes.title: ☎️ Mission Alert: IEYTD3: Launch Dates Revealed in NEW MR Trailer
notes.content:
It’s finally declassified. [i]I Expect You To Die 3[/i] will be released on SteamVR on September 28, 2023.
Ready to be fully immersed in your new missions, Agents? 🌭

We have new intel, so grab your popcorn 🍿 and settle in 📺 for our new [i]I Expect You To Die 3[/i] mixed-reality launch date announcement trailer — time to get a taste of the soon-to-be-released action. 

[previewyoutube=pgjckhtKFU8;full][/previewyoutube]
🎮 Enter the third installment of the beloved spy-fy VR franchise with a world of complex puzzles, exciting espionage, and a bit of hilarity thrown in to round out this fun-filled adventure.

Get ready to officially:
[list]
[*][b]Race to Beat Dr. Zor:[/b] Assignments take place in some of the most dangerous and expansive locales to date, and each one will require Agents to deploy their most advanced covert spy skills. These six fast-paced missions will leave even the most seasoned players breathless.
[*][b]Meet a Brilliant Mastermind:[/b] Dr. Roxana Prism, scientist and former Agency inventor, believes she can create a better agent, one that’s superior to humans. The mission: stay alive long enough to defeat this new escalating threat.
[*][b]Go Undercover in Style:[/b] Agents can show off their style (undercover, of course) with an imaginative array of Agency-approved attire. Now they can unlock their hat, watch, and gloves before embarking on any of their top-secret missions.[/list]And that’s not all, Agents — help us celebrate the upcoming launch of your new missions with [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/8Y8PVwINKVA?feature=share]a special livestream[/url] [b]at 12pm PT/3pm ET on August 17[/b]! 

We’ll be talking with members of the [i]IEYTD3[/i] development team about how they went about expanding the [i]I Expect You To Die[/i] series and what goes into creating the series’ iconic opening credit sequences. 

A final reminder that eager Agents can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296380/I_Expect_You_To_Die_3/?utm_campaign=ieytd3_mrtrailer_steamblog_wishlist&utm_medium=steam&utm_source=steam&utm_content=&utm_term=launch]wishlist [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] on Steam[/url]. This really helps out the Agency, so we appreciate it!

Zor waits for no one, Agents. We’ll need you when you least expect it! 

Stay sharp. ☎️

notes.title: 🎶 Mission Update: The I Expect You To Die 3 Opening Credits Theme DECLASSIFIED!
notes.content:
🎶 Listen up, Agents! 

Today, [b]the Agency revealed our top secret opening credits for [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine.[/i][/b]

[previewyoutube=J4KgdaWF03E;full][/previewyoutube]
📃 [b]Featuring a declassified soulful single by singer, songwriter, and actress [url=https://www.haleyreinhart.com/]Haley Reinhart[/url][/b], Agents can now get a closer look and listen at their upcoming mission. 

Of course, we couldn’t help but to share this lovely briefing from Agent Reinhart. 🎤
[quote]“Paying homage to the 1960’s spy-fi inspired world of [i]I Expect You To Die[/i] drew me to this project initially,” said singer Haley Reinhart. “My performance was inspired by the energy of the opening sequences of the first two games along with the sweeping melodies and robust orchestral sound featured on ‘Cog In The Machine.’ It was an absolute thrill to work with such an amazing team and channel a James Bond-like vocal performance (e.g. Shirley Bassey). I can’t wait for the world to experience it!”[/quote]We’re assuming you’ve already listened, Agent and can’t get enough of the new single “Cog in the Machine” — we know, it’s glorious. Luckily for you, the Agency is also releasing the full [b][i]I Expect You To Die 3 Soundtrack[/i][/b] exclusively on our Schell Games YouTube channel. 

🎶 Listen to the full album [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLINVNan6DCzqgOGV5G3VaoNa9qHbyuRlo]here[/url] 🎶 and share your applause and favorite tracks with fellow Agents in the [url=https://discord.gg/ieytd][i]IEYTD[/i] Discord[/url]!

🦾 So we ask you again, Agents, after [i]quite literally[/i] hearing this news, will you be able to prove yourself against Dr. Roxana Prism, and her questionable robot underlings? Do you have what it takes? Will. You. Be. Ready?

For those of you who haven’t received the Agency memos yet, [i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/i] launches Fall 2023 for Steam. Eager Agents can now wishlist the [i]IEYTD3[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296380/I_Expect_You_To_Die_3/]here[/url].

notes.title: Mission Alert: New Schell Games Discord
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents! 📩 We have a very special invitation for you —

[h2]We’re excited to announce that Agents can now join the new [url=https://bit.ly/3HxZLrH][b]Schell Games Discord[/b][/url]! [/h2]

The Schell Games Discord server will include channels for most of our games (with the exception of [i]I Expect You To Die[/i] 💣 and [i]Among Us VR[/i] 🚨), and feature a strong focus on the ⚔ [i]Until You Fall [/i]⚔ community. 

While [url=https://discord.gg/ieytd]the official [i]I Expect You To Die[/i] Discord server[/url] isn’t going anywhere — we’re looking forward to having fans of all our different games chatting and interacting together. So, we’d love to see as many Agents reporting to this additional server as well to get a wider scope of our Schell Games library and arsenal! 🕵

This larger, all-encompassing server is a new initiative for the Schell Games team, so we welcome your feedback in order to make the new server feel as welcoming as possible.

As one final point — this means we’re also looking for new community moderators to join the Schell Games server team! 📣 [b]If you would like to apply to be a moderator for the new server, [url=https://bit.ly/40rjzDA]please apply here![/url][/b]

We hope to see you there, Agents!

Stay sharp!

notes.title: Mission Alert: I Expect You To Die 3 Teaser Announcement is Here, Agents!
notes.content:
The Agency needs you again, Agent!

[b][h3]📣 📣 📣 Prepare yourself for new missions! 📣 📣 📣 [/h3][/b]
Outwit your most cunning adversary to date in [b][i]I Expect You To Die 3: Cog in the Machine[/b][/i], the third installment of the beloved spy-themed VR puzzle series. 

As an elite secret agent, you’ll experience brand-new missions, wield fresh gadgets, visit action-packed environments, and interface with robots — all while harnessing your power of telekinesis and wearing custom attire as you dive back into the world of espionage. 

[previewyoutube=_kFmrUfRDJg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]Scope out the new mission (teaser 👀) here![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]🔍 Additional Agency Intel:[/b][/h3]
Your skills — and survival rate — make you one of our most capable agents, and you’ve resurfaced right on time. The Zoraxis Organization, our sworn enemy, has something new up its sleeves and we fear dire consequences if we don’t stop its diabolical schemes. We’re counting on you to throw a wrench into whatever evil they have brewing. 
[list][b]🛞Race to Beat Dr. Zor [/b]
Your assignments take place in some of the most dangerous locales to date, and each one will require your most advanced covert agent skills. These fast-paced missions will leave you breathless.[/list][list][b]🧠Meet a Brilliant Mastermind[/b]
A brand new villain will test even the most seasoned agents, and it is up to you to stay alive long enough to defeat this incoming threat before the clock stops ticking.[/list][list][b]🧥Go Undercover in Style[/b]
Show off your style (undercover, of course) with an imaginative array of Agency-approved attire. Choose your hat, watch, and gloves before embarking on your top-secret missions to stay looking sharp![/list]Protect the Agency — and the world as we know it — without losing your wits…or your life! ☠️ 


Stay tuned for the latest intel, Agents!

notes.title: I Expect You To Die 2 Launches August 24, 2021!
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!
The Agency knows you've been waiting, so we're pleased to finally be able to declassify this intel:

[h3][i]I Expect You To Die 2: The Spy and The Liar[/i] will launch on August 24, 2021![/h3]

To celebrate, we've released [url=https://iexpectyoutodie.schellgames.com/news/i-expect-you-to-die-2-the-spy-and-the-liar-launching-on-all-major-vr-platforms-on-august-24]a batch of new intel[/url], including a brand-new trailer. 
[previewyoutube=wVGSWFQynyg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope that you're excited as we are about this information. You can join in on the hype and trailer sleuthing on [url=https://discord.com/invite/ieytd]our official Discord server[/url]. Or, add the game to your Wishlist! Or, better yet, do both!

Stay sharp, Agents!

notes.title: INCOMING TRANSMISSION: Steam Next Fest Next Week!
notes.content:
Greetings, Agents!

HQ wanted to send a quick reminder to you that [i]I Expect You To Die 2: The Spy and The Liar[/i] will be part of Steam Next Fest! The event starts next week, Wednesday, June 16.
We're thrilled to declassify more information about the upcoming sequel and gather all of your feedback about the playable demo that will put you back on the field.

There will be plenty of more intel to share soon, but for now, here's a sneak peek at what's coming up next week:
[list]
[*] Playable Demo of [i]I Expect You To Die 2: The Spy and The Liar[/i]
[*] Developer Livestream with Project Director Charlie Amis
[*] Content Creator Livestreams, featuring SteveKnows and Vaeriana
[/list]We hope you'll be prepared for an explosive good time when the curtain rises next week!

Of course, if you're dying to chat about your speculations, theories, or hype in the meantime: we expected that. Other field Agents are gathering on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GUmt6WsRmS]official [i]I Expect You To Die Discord[/i] server[/url], and HQ would highly recommend you join the ranks. 

Stay sharp!
